"import cadquery as cq

# Establish the YZ plane: local (u, v) -> global (0, u, v)
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Define the 7 line segments in local sketch coordinates (u, v)
segments = [
    ((-8, -12), (21, -12)),
    ((21, -12), (21,   5)),
    ((21,   5), (9,    5)),
    ((9,    5), (9,   26)),
    ((9,   26), (31,  26)),
    ((31,  26), (31,  44)),
    ((31,  44), (-3,  44)),
]

# Build exactly 7 line edges, all on the YZ plane
edges = []
for (u1, v1), (u2, v2) in segments:
    p1 = P.toWorldCoords((u1, v1))
    p2 = P.toWorldCoords((u2, v2))
    edges.append(cq.Edge.makeLine(p1, p2))

# Export the open edge chain as a STEP file
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
